# Summary

This year the company grew its customer base by a fifth and opened two new offices. Costs rose more slowly than revenue, and the operating margin improved for the third year running.

# Outlook

Next year we expect slower growth as the new offices settle in. The main risks are hiring and the exchange rate, both covered in the appendix to the full report.
